passages.question: When are a calendar-year corporation's installments due, and when may last year's tax be used?
passages.excerpt: Installment payments are due by the 15th day of the 4th, 6th, 9th, and 12th months of the corporation's tax year. Example 1. Your corporation's tax year ends December 31. Installment payments are due on April 15, June 15, September 15, and December 15. ... Method 2. Each required installment is 25% of the income tax shown on the corporation's return for the previous year. ... the return must have been for a full 12 months, and the return must have shown a positive tax liability (not zero).

passages.question: What does the estimated tax worksheet compute?
passages.excerpt: This worksheet may be used as a guide in figuring the required estimated tax installments. ... Enter the tax shown on the corporation's prior year's tax return. ... Enter the smaller of line 8 or line 9. ... Required installments. Enter 25% of line 10. ... Form 1120-W, Estimated Tax for Corporations, is now historical.

passages.question: What must go with the 2026 return if the annualized method is used, and should HANGS catch up now?
passages.excerpt: An immediate catch-up payment should be made to reduce any penalty resulting from the underpayment of any earlier installments. ... Even if the corporation does not owe a penalty, complete and attach the form to the corporation's tax return if any of the following apply. The annualized income installment method was used to figure any required installment.
